results.snippet: If you're comparing platforms, check our analysis of Reddit ads vs Google ads and Reddit ads vs TikTok ads to understand cost efficiency across channels. Setting your Reddit CPC bid is a balance between winning enough auctions and protecting margin. A bid that is too low never enters competitive auctions, while a bid far above the category norm burns budget on clicks that would have cost less. Start by researching the average CPC for your vertical, then set an opening bid roughly 10 to 15 percent above that benchmark to secure early delivery and learning data.
